newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly steady to lower Monday as dealers said they were carefully watching the decline of CBOT grain and oilseed prices.

"Right now, the millfeed markets are trying to hold their own," a Minneapolis dealer said. Depending on what corn and soybeans do for the rest of the day, on Tuesday millfeed markets may stay the same or go down, the dealer added.
In North Carolina, one dealer said animals continued to eat less feed in his region because of the heat.
But elsewhere, nearby supplies remained tight in northern Texas, a Texas broker said.
"There are still people needing nearby midds. I know the grain markets are a little bit weaker but supplies have been tight," he said.
